breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly resolved this by specifying only the Dirichlet boundary conditions ('Enforce Dirichlet boundary conditions u=0 on all four edges...') and explicitly stating 'Do not apply periodic boundary conditions anywhere.', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth's correction.
